record.context_brief: Large families of sign constraints in l1
record.original_question: Fix θ with 1/2<θ<1. Let F\subset\{-1,0,1\}^ℕ be a set of infinite sign sequences, and for each N let F_N be the set of prefixes δ_1,⋯,δ_N\in\{-1,0,1\}^N that can be continued to some element of F; write π_N(θ,F)=\#F_N. Suppose π_N(θ,F)	o∞ as N	o∞. If a=(a_1,a_2,⋯)\in l_1 satisfies ∑ ε_n a_n=0 for every ε\in F, must a_n/θ^n be constant?

evidence.quote: Let F be a set of sequences ε = ε1ε2 . . . , εν ∈ {− 1, 0, 1}. Let FN be the set of those sequences δ1, . . . , δN ∈ {−1, 0, 1}N which can be continued by suitable εν ∈ {−1, 0, 1}(ν = N + 1, N + 2, . . .) such that δ1 . . . , δN εN +1εN +2 · · · ∈ F . Let πN (Θ, F ) = #( FN ).
Conjecture 5. Let F be such a set of ε ∈ {−1, 0, 1}N, for which πN (θ | F) → ∞ (N → ∞). Let a = a1a2 · · · ∈ l1 be such a sequence for which ∑ εnan = 0 whenever ε ∈ F . Then an/θn = constant.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Fix a real number $\theta$ with $1/2 < \theta < 1$. Let $F \subset \{-1,0,1\}^{\mathbb{N}}$ be a set of infinite sign sequences $\varepsilon = (\varepsilon_1, \varepsilon_2, \ldots)$ with $\varepsilon_n \in \{-1,0,1\}$. For each positive integer $N$, define $F_N \subset \{-1,0,1\}^N$ to be the set of all finite prefixes $(\delta_1, \ldots, \delta_N)$ which can be extended by some tail $(\varepsilon_{N+1}, \varepsilon_{N+2}, \ldots) \in \{-1,0,1\}^{\mathbb{N}}$ so that the concatenation $(\delta_1, \ldots, \delta_N, \varepsilon_{N+1}, \varepsilon_{N+2}, \ldots)$ belongs to $F$. Set $\pi_N(\theta, F) = \#F_N$, and assume $\pi_N(\theta, F) \to \infty$ as $N \to \infty$.

Suppose $a = (a_1, a_2, \ldots) \in \ell_1$ satisfies
$$\sum_{n=1}^{\infty} \varepsilon_n a_n = 0 \quad \text{for every } \varepsilon = (\varepsilon_n) \in F.$$
Prove or disprove: the sequence $a_n / \theta^n$ must be constant in $n$.
artifact.status_search_result: A targeted search did not surface a published resolution of this conjecture concerning sign-sequence annihilators of $\ell_1$ sequences for $\theta \in (1/2,1)$. It was posed as an open conjecture in work surrounding Daróczy-type problems, and no clear proof or counterexample could be confirmed.

status_evidence.snippet: Conjecture 5 states that if π_N(θ|F) → ∞ and a ∈ l_1 satisfies Σ ε_n a_n = 0 for all ε ∈ F, then a_n/θ^n = constant.
status_evidence.claim: The statement is recorded as a conjecture, indicating it was open at the time of writing.
